desc:
💾 All of your builds save on a private server! So you can continue building later :)

🧱 Build Anything – Place blocks to create whatever you imagine.
👥 Multiplayer Mode – Team up or build solo in shared worlds.
🎮 Simple Fun – No rules, just building!
🎨 Creative Freedom – Express your imagination with no limits.

Changelog:

06/21:
🚗 Introducing vehicles: Hoverboard, car and rocket! Use them to bring your builds to life :)
🖼️ Today's top build: Starting from now, you can submit a screenshot of your builds on our communications server. Every day we'll choose the best build to be displayed at the spawn for everybody to see!
06/14:
🚪 Doors are finally here. Try them out!
